title: Top 10 Viewpoints in Madeira: The Best Miradouros and When to Go
description: The 10 best viewpoints in Madeira, from the Cabo Girão skywalk to Pico do Arieiro, with tips on timing, access and how to see the coastline from the sea.
heroAlt: The towering basalt wall of Cabo Girao rising from the sea

images.prompt: A real-looking wide photograph of the sheer basalt wall of Cabo Girão rising from the Atlantic on Madeira's south coast, soft late afternoon light, seen from the sea.
images.alt: The Cabo Girão sea cliff on Madeira's south coast seen from the water

images.prompt: A real-looking photograph of Pico do Arieiro at sunrise in Madeira, jagged volcanic peaks rising above a sea of cloud in warm pink light, viewed from the summit path.
images.alt: Sunrise over a sea of cloud at Pico do Arieiro

images.prompt: A real-looking photograph of Funchal's bay and hillside houses at golden hour, seen from a hillside viewpoint in Madeira, with a small white motorboat in the harbour.
images.alt: Funchal and its bay at golden hour from a hillside viewpoint
